v15-12.candidate: Samuel rose early and went to meet Israel in the morning. Samuel was told, “Saul has come to Carmel, erected a hand for himself, and turned the chariot around.” He went down to Saul at Gilgal, and behold, Saul was offering the first of the spoils brought from Amalek as a whole burnt offering to the Lord.

v15-23.candidate: For divination is sin; teraphim bring sorrow and troubles. Because you treated the Lord’s word as nothing, the Lord will treat you as nothing, so that you will not be king over Israel.”
v15-23.display:
For divination is sin;
teraphim bring sorrow and troubles.
Because you treated the Lord’s word as nothing,
the Lord will treat you as nothing,
so that you will not be king over Israel.”

v15-24.candidate: Saul said to Samuel, “I have sinned, for I transgressed the Lord’s word and your word, for I feared the people and listened to their voice.

v16-7.candidate: The Lord said to Samuel, “Do not look at his appearance or the bearing of his height, for I have treated him as nothing. For God does not see as a human looks: a human looks at the face, but God looks at the heart.”

v16-11.candidate: Samuel said to Jesse, “Are these all the boys?” He said, “There is still the youngest; behold, he is tending the flock.” Samuel said to Jesse, “Send and fetch him, for we will certainly not recline until he comes.”

v16-15.candidate: Saul’s servants said to him, “Behold, an evil spirit of the Lord is choking you.

v16-18.candidate: One of his young servants answered, “Behold, I have seen a son of Jesse, a Beth-lehemite, skilled in playing. The man is discerning, a warrior, wise in speech, and good in appearance; the Lord is with him.”

v16-21.candidate: David came to Saul and stood before him. Saul loved him greatly, and David became the one carrying his equipment.

v15-22.display:
Samuel said,
“Are whole burnt offerings and sacrifices as desirable to the Lord
as listening to the Lord’s voice?
Behold, obedience is better than sacrifice,
and attentiveness than the fat of rams.
